concise_default.description: Keep future drafts concise unless the query asks for detailed narrative.

include_risk_section.description: Include a distinct Risk Flags section when source evidence supports risks, uncertainty, deadlines, defaults, or exceptions.

prefer_bullets.description: Prefer concise bullet points over dense paragraphs for reviewable legal drafts.

respect_operator_section_order.description: Reuse the operator's accepted section order when generating the same draft type.

strict_citations.description: Avoid unsupported claims; every factual statement should carry a citation or be moved to gaps.
